Average power values help: Only affects power values (W/kW). Enable for regularly updated power sensors. Leave disabled for devices that switch on and off abruptly.
Alias changes only the display name; the: Alias changes only the display name; the generated state ID remains unchanged
Meter reading at the beginning of the da: Meter reading at the beginning of the day
Meter reading at the beginning of the mo: Meter reading at the beginning of the month
Meter reading at the beginning of the qu: Meter reading at the beginning of the quarter
Meter reading at the beginning of the we: Meter reading at the beginning of the week
Meter reading at the beginning of the ye: Meter reading at the beginning of the year
Name: Name
Name help: Readable display name of the generated SourceAnalytix device
Output ID help: Technical ID below this SourceAnalytix instance. Changing an existing ID migrates its values, but scripts, visualizations and external history references must be adjusted.
Output ID format error: The ID is invalid, reserved or already in use
Unit required error: No supported unit was detected. Please select a unit
Threshold value of device reset detectio: Threshold value of device reset detection
Ignore negative power values help: Only affects power values (W/kW). Negative readings count as 0 W. Enable for inverters that report a negative power while they are switched off.
Rounding decimals help: Initial value copied into newly configured sources. Existing sources keep their own value. Use -1 to store the exact value without rounding.
Individual rounding decimals help: Use -1 to store the exact value without rounding.
Start values header: Start values of the running periods
Start values help: Total at the beginning of the running day, week, month, quarter and year, in the unit of the price definition (for example kWh, not Wh). They only apply to the running periods; at the next period change SourceAnalytix sets them itself. Leave a field empty to count from now on. Comma or dot as decimal mark, no thousands separator.
Current total help: Total of this source in the unit of the selected price definition when the dialog was opened. No start value may be larger.
Start value error: Invalid start value: use a number without thousands separator. It must not be larger than the current total, and a period that began earlier (for example the year) cannot have a larger start value than a later one (for example the month).
Maximum gap help: Only affects power values (W/kW). If no new value arrives for longer, the last value is not extended over the pause: the interval counts as 0 and is logged. Empty or 0 = off, for devices that only send on change.
Basic rate shared hint: Another source with this price definition already includes the basic fee. Every source books the full basic fee, so it is counted several times. If the sources belong to one connection, enable "Including basic rate" on one source only.
Pulses per unit: Pulses per unit of the price definition
Pulses per unit help: Only for the units piece and piece/min (pulses). Example: 1000 for a meter with 1000 imp/kWh and a price definition in kWh. Empty: the price definition must use the unit piece.
Each update adds its value help: For data points that send one update per pulse or a consumption increment instead of a meter reading, for example 1 or true per pulse, or 0.001 kWh per pulse. Every update is added, also an unchanged value. Negative values are ignored.
Start value scale hint: A start value is larger than the current total but would fit after dividing by 1000. Was it entered in Wh instead of kWh, or in l instead of m³? Start values use the unit of the price definition.
Custom settings moved hint: Here you only switch SourceAnalytix on or off for this datapoint. Price definition, unit, start values and all other settings are set up in the SourceAnalytix instance settings. An enabled source without a price definition appears there on the "Problems" tab.
Price changed without new valid from: Price changed but "Valid from" did not: the new price replaces the old one retroactively. Set a new date?
